name: pineX Commerce Suite
author: Babar DOgar

sections.description:
pineX Commerce Suite replaces four separate storefront plugins with one fast, zero-bloat WooCommerce conversion toolkit. Engineered natively for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and PHP 8.3+, it creates zero custom database tables and makes zero third-party API requests, keeping your store fast, clean, and easy to maintain.

Trademark Notice: pineX Commerce Suite is an independent software product developed by pineX digital and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WooCommerce or Automattic Inc.

Core Features (100% Free & Unlocked)

  • AJAX Slide-Out Cart Drawer: Instant glassmorphic fly-out cart drawer with live + / - quantity steppers, one-click item removal, real-time WooCommerce fragment synchronization, automatic drawer opening on add-to-cart, floating cart dock, and [pinex_wcs_cart_trigger] shortcode / Gutenberg block.
  • Dynamic Free-Shipping Progress Bar: Live visual progress bar inside the slide-out cart drawer that automatically calculates how much more a shopper needs to add to unlock free shipping.
  • Visual Color & Size Variation Swatches: Automatically transforms standard WooCommerce variation dropdowns into interactive color circles and size pill buttons—supporting custom color hex mappings and full WooCommerce variation reset compatibility.
  • Custom Product Text & Engraving Fields: Add per-product personalization, engraving, or gift-note input boxes directly on WooCommerce single product pages with optional required validation, cart summary display, and WooCommerce HPOS order item metadata persistence.
  • Modular Switchboard: Enable or disable any of the four modules independently with smart dependency handling and instant visual customization.

Optional Pro Companion Extension

Looking for in-cart and post-purchase 1-click order bumps, tiered cart milestone rewards (free gifts & auto-discounts), customer artwork file uploads, store credit wallet cashback, B2B quantity-break pricing tables, and customer-controlled recurring reorders? Learn more about the separate pineX Commerce Suite Pro companion plugin at pinex.co.uk.

Configuration & Quick Start

  1. Navigate to pineX Suite -> Command Center in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  2. Toggle any module on or off in the Modular Switchboard.
  3. Set your Free Shipping Goal, customize the progress bar messages, accent colors, and swatch shape, and click Save Configuration.
  4. To enable custom text or engraving fields on a product, edit any WooCommerce product and open Product Data -> General to enable Custom Text Field.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure WooCommerce 9.0 or newer is installed and active on a server running PHP 8.3 or newer and WordPress 6.9 or newer.
  2. Upload the pinex-commerce-suite folder to /wp-content/plugins/pinex-commerce-suite/, or install pinex-commerce-suite.zip via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin in WordPress.
  3. Activate pineX Commerce Suite through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Configure your cart drawer, shipping goal, and swatches under pineX Suite -> Command Center.
sections.faq:
Does pineX Commerce Suite create any custom database tables?

No. pineX Commerce Suite uses native WordPress options and WooCommerce HPOS order/product metadata exclusively, leaving your database schema 100% clean.

Does pineX Commerce Suite work with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. pineX Commerce Suite explicitly declares full compatibility with WooCommerce custom_order_tables (HPOS) and cart_checkout_blocks.

Does this plugin connect to any external servers or load third-party CDNs?

No. Every stylesheet and script is 100% self-contained inside the plugin package and enqueued via native WordPress wp_enqueue_style() and wp_enqueue_script() functions.

How do I embed the slide-out cart button in my header or navigation?

Use the [pinex_wcs_cart_trigger] shortcode or insert the pineX Cart Trigger block inside any block theme header or widget area.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release for WordPress 6.9-7.1, WooCommerce 9.0-11.3 (HPOS & Cart/Checkout Blocks), and PHP 8.3-8.5.
  • Added AJAX Slide-Out Cart Drawer with live quantity steppers, instant item removal, automatic drawer open on add-to-cart, floating dock, and [pinex_wcs_cart_trigger] shortcode/block.
  • Added Dynamic Free-Shipping Progress Bar with customizable threshold and progress/unlocked messages.
  • Added Visual Color & Size Variation Swatches with custom color hex mappings.
  • Added per-product Custom Text / Engraving Fields persisted to WooCommerce HPOS order line items.
  • Added Modular Switchboard with dependency protection and zero custom database tables.
